question: Estimate the brand recall reach of a celebrity-endorsed TVC featuring a top-tier star.
idealClarificationQuestions: Top-tier star = Shah Rukh Khan / Virat Kohli / Deepika Padukone level? Yes.
Reach = unique people aware of the brand-celebrity association after a 3-month TVC blitz? Yes.
Budget ~₹30 cr media + endorsement fee? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TV reach + digital reach + earned media (PR) reach.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TV reach over 3 months at 5,000+ GRPs across Hindi GEC + sports + movies: ~70-75 crore TV individuals (1+ reach), ~50 cr (3+).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Digital reach (YouTube + Meta + OTT) at ~₹5 cr digital media: ~20 crore unique.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total cumulative cross-media reach (deduped): ~70-80 crore unique Indians.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, recall the celebrity-brand association: ~40-50% = ~30-40 crore have spontaneous recall.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Digital reach (YouTube + Meta + OTT) at ~₹5 cr digital media
Of these, recall the celebrity-brand association

calculationFlow: TV reach over 3 months at 5,000+ GRPs across Hindi GEC + sports + movies: ~70-75 crore TV individuals (1+ reach), ~50 cr (3+).
Digital reach (YouTube + Meta + OTT) at ~₹5 cr digital media: ~20 crore unique.
Earned media / PR (interviews, branded content): ~15 crore additional.
Total cumulative cross-media reach (deduped): ~70-80 crore unique Indians.
Of these, recall the celebrity-brand association: ~40-50% = ~30-40 crore have spontaneous recall.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Of these, recall the celebrity-brand association: ~40-50% = ~30-40 crore have spontaneous recall.
